evidence.notes: Local Database.getDeleted returns tombstoned records whose deleted timestamp falls inside the requested sync window.
GetDeletedResult exposes matching local DeletedRecord DTOs.
DeletedRecord exposes the deleted local record Id.
DeletedRecord exposes the deleted local record Id.
DeletedRecord exposes the local deletion Date.
DeletedRecord exposes the local deletion Date.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseDeletedSyncWindowFixtureTest { @isTest static void deletedWindowReturnsMatchingRecords() { Datetime startWindow = Datetime.now(); Account account = new Account(Name = 'Delete Me'); insert account; Id accountId = account.Id; delete account; Datetime endWindow = Datetime.now().addMinutes(1); Database.GetDeletedResult inside = Database.getDeleted('Account', startWindow, endWindow); Database.DeletedRecord deleted; for (Database.DeletedRecord candidate : inside.getDeletedRecords()) { if (candidate.getId() == accountId) { deleted = candidate; break; } } System.assertNotEquals(null, deleted); System.assertEquals(accountId, deleted.getId()); Datetime deletedDate = deleted.getDeletedDate(); System.assert(deletedDate >= startWindow.addMinutes(-1)); System.assert(deletedDate <= endWindow); Date earliest = inside.getEarliestDateAvailable(); Date latest = inside.getLatestDateCovered(); if (earliest != null && latest != null) { System.assert(earliest <= latest); } Database.GetDeletedResult outside = Database.getDeleted('Account', endWindow.addMinutes(1), endWindow.addMinutes(2)); System.assertEquals(0, outside.getDeletedRecords().size()); } }
